events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and the US has shown its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The Atlantic Council has outlined four scenarios for geopolitics after the Iran war.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased volatility in the market, and gold is likely to benefit as a safe-haven asset. Emerging markets, on the other hand, may suffer due to the increased uncertainty.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the Iran war de-escalates or if gold prices drop below $1,500

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia has announced plans to expand its AI chip production, and its partnership with TSMC is expected to advance semiconductor fabrication.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's AI spending and partnerships are expected to drive growth in the company's stock price. The semiconductor ETF is also likely to benefit from the trend.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the company's earnings report and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if Nvidia's stock price drops below $500 or if the semiconductor ETF underperforms
